definitions.gloss: either way; in any case; regardless; no matter which
definitions.explanation: Used to indicate that the outcome or conclusion remains the same regardless of which option is chosen. Functions as a sentence-initial or mid-sentence connector.

examples.japanese: どちらにしても⟦{行|い}か→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Either way, I have to go.

examples.japanese: どちらにしても⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think the result will be the same either way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、どちらにしても⟦{今日中|きょうじゅう}→今日中：19382_kyoujuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}さ→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Whether you're for it or against it, either way we have to reach a conclusion by the end of today.

notes:
A common conversational connector used to move a discussion forward when the specific choice between options does not matter. Often appears at the beginning of a sentence to shift focus to what remains constant regardless of the options.

FORMS:
- ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦せよ→する：00392_suru⟧: slightly more formal variant
- ⟦どっち→どっち：02922_docchi⟧にして⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: casual variant using ⟦どっち→どっち：02922_docchi⟧
- ⟦いずれにしても→いずれにしても：30653_izurenishitemo⟧: more formal equivalent

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Aで⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧B⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧、どちらにしても〜: whether A or B, either way ~
- どちらにしても⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: it doesn't change either way

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いずれにしても→いずれにしても：30653_izurenishitemo⟧: in any case — more formal, used in writing and formal speech
- ⟦どっちにしろ→どっちにしろ：19735_docchinishiro⟧: either way — casual, slightly blunt
- ⟦とにかく→とにかく：03464_tonikaku⟧: anyway, in any case — shifts topic rather than comparing options
